description: ClinVar GATAD2B variant spectrum: classification and molecular consequence of pathogenic variants
code:
import requests, json, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
r=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",term="GATAD2B[gene]",retmax=1000,retmode="json"),timeout=60)
ids=r.json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    rr=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",id=",".join(ids[i:i+200]),retmode="json"),timeout=120)
    j=rr.json()["result"]
    for uid in j.get("uids",[]):
        d=j[uid]; g=d.get("germline_classification",{}); vs=(d.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]
        recs.append(dict(title=d.get("title",""),clinsig=g.get("description",""),
                         review=g.get("review_status",""),vtype=vs.get("variant_type","")))
    time.sleep(0.4)
df=pd.DataFrame(recs)

plp=df[df.clinsig.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])].copy()

def cons(row):
    t=row.title
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+[A-Z][a-z]{2}fs",t): return "frameshift"
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+Ter\)",t): return "nonsense"
    if re.search(r"c\.-?\d+[\+\-]\d+[ACGT]>[ACGT]",t) or re.search(r"c\.\d+[\+\-]\d+",t): return "splice-site"
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+[A-Z][a-z]{2}\)",t): return "missense"
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+del",t): return "in-frame deletion"
    if row.vtype in ("copy number loss","Deletion"): return "deletion (CNV/indel)"
    if row.vtype in ("copy number gain","Duplication"): return "duplication (CNV)"
    return "other"
plp["cons"]=plp.apply(cons,axis=1)
vc=plp.cons.value_counts()
lof=vc.reindex(["frameshift","nonsense","splice-site","deletion (CNV/indel)"]).fillna(0).sum()
print("Total ClinVar GATAD2B records:",len(df))
print(df.clinsig.replace("","no classification").value_counts(),"\n")
print("P/LP n =",len(plp)); print(vc)
print("\nTruncating/LoF-type share of P/LP: %.1f%%"%(100*lof/len(plp)))
print("Missense share of P/LP: %.1f%%"%(100*vc.get("missense",0)/len(plp)))
print("\nVUS share of all records: %.1f%%"%(100*(df.clinsig=="Uncertain significance").sum()/len(df)))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5))
a=df.clinsig.replace("","no classification").value_counts()
axes[0].barh(a.index[::-1],a.values[::-1],color="#4C72B0")
axes[0].set_xlabel("ClinVar records"); axes[0].set_title("GATAD2B germline classifications (n=%d)"%len(df))
for i,v in enumerate(a.values[::-1]): axes[0].text(v+5,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=9)
axes[1].barh(vc.index[::-1],vc.values[::-1],color="#C44E52")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Pathogenic / likely pathogenic records")
axes[1].set_title("Molecular consequence of P/LP variants (n=%d)"%len(plp))
for i,v in enumerate(vc.values[::-1]): axes[1].text(v+0.5,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
